name: Emerald Dreams: Sanity -  Platformer Quest
detailed_description:
Game Description

Emerald Dreams: Sanity - Platformer Quest is an exciting 2.5D platformer and adventure Metroidvania that takes you on a journey through mysterious worlds filled with puzzles to solve and treacherous monsters to defeat. The game offers a rich story set in a dark fantasy universe where every decision you make can lead to one of multiple endings (Multiple Endings).

Key Features

• Multi-layered gameplay and unique puzzles: Expect not just in-game challenges but also puzzles that extend beyond the game itself, encouraging you to seek answers outside the traditional game environment. Explore dark corners and unlock hidden areas in classic Metroidvania style.
• Sanity system: Immerse yourself in the psychological state of your character, which influences their perception of the world and unlocks new possibilities and storylines. Every step in your Exploration alters your perspective on the unfolding events.
• Free game with community support: Emerald Dreams: Sanity is available for free to ensure everyone can enjoy our project. Support us by purchasing an exclusive art book or making a small voluntary contribution, and your name will be credited in the game. The game has an Indie vibe, showcasing a unique approach to world-building.
• Interactive elements beyond the game: Experience a game that extends beyond the screen, where interacting with external files and websites is crucial to your progress.
• Psychological horror: Immerse yourself in a psychological horror that blurs the lines between game and reality, keeping you on edge even after you turn off your computer.
• Rich narrative and multiple endings: Explore a rich narrative with multiple endings, driven by your choices and the ever-shifting state of your character's mind.
• Atmospheric world and intricate mechanics: Uncover a beautifully crafted pixel world filled with eerie locations and haunting music, designed to pull you deeper into its dark fantasy setting.

Why Early Access?

We chose the early access model to allow players to immerse themselves in our world and help us improve it. Your feedback and support will help us create the best possible gaming experience, adding new exciting elements like levels and characters. Dive into the game's atmosphere and uncover its mysteries.

Current Development Stage


The game already has a main storyline and unique game mechanics, but we need to fine-tune the balance and add new levels and characters. We are actively working to make the game as engaging and full of surprises as possible. Journey through dark kingdoms, meet strange creatures, and navigate complex platforming levels.

How Long Will Early Access Last?


We plan to stay in early access for about a year to gather feedback and make all necessary improvements. Your support will help us create the best final product, which will include new action and gameplay possibilities.

What Will Be Different in the Full Version?


The full version of the game will include more levels, new characters, expanded storylines, and additional game modes. We also plan to add localization for several languages and port the game to consoles. Test your skills in challenging trials and face mighty bosses.

How Do You Plan to Involve the Community?


We actively engage with players through Steam forums and social media. Everyone who supports us financially will be credited in the game and will have a say in the project's development. Join our community and help us make the game better. Experience the intensity of the psychological challenges that lie ahead.

Monetization Model


The game will be free for all users. We offer two ways to support the development:
1. Purchase the art book: Support the project by buying an art book, which will allow you to enjoy unique illustrations and concept art. Appreciate the high quality of hand-drawn animation and unique style.
2. Voluntary donation : Support us with a small contribution and get your name in the game credits.
